paite: Huan Pathian in Jakobiang hohtou in, huai ah teng in. Na u Esau a kipan na taimang lai a, na kiang a kilak Pathian a ding in huai mun ah maitam doh in," achi hi.
heading: Bethel Ah Pathian In Jakob Avualzawl
english: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

paite: Jakob in a-inkuanpihte leh akiang a om tengteng kiang ah, "Na lak ua om gamdang pathiante koihmang unla, kihihsiangthou unla, na puansilhte uh kheng un.
english: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

paite: I thou ding ua, Bethel ah i paitou ding uh. Ka lungzin lai a hon dawng, ka paina a ka kiang a om zel Pathian a ding in maitam ka doh ding," achi hi.
english: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

paite: Huchi in gamdang pathiante akhut ua om tengteng leh abil ua bilbah abah tengteng uh Jakob kiang ah apekhe vek uhi. Jakob in Shekem kho kiang a tosaw nuai ah aphum hi.
english: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

paite: Apai ua, akim ua khuate'n alau mahmah ua, Jakob tapate adelh kei uhi.
english: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

paite: Jakob leh akiang a om tengteng toh, Kanaan gam a om Luz khua, huai Bethel kichi atung a,
english: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

paite: huai ah maitam adoh a, a-u a kipan ataimang lai a, akiang a Pathian akilak ziak in huai mun min El-bethel asa hi.
english: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

paite: Huan Rebekah donnu Deborah asi a, Bethel khang a tosaw nuai ah avui ua; tosaw min Allon-bakuth asa uhi.
english: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

paite: Padan-aram gam a kipan Jakob ahong tun in akiang ah Pathian akilak nawn a, avualzawl hi.
english: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

paite: Pathian in akiang ah, "Na min Jakob ahi a; na min Jakob ahi nawn kei ding a, na min Israel ahi zawta ding,” achi hi. Huchi in amin Israel asata hi.
english: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

paite: Pathian mah in akiang ah, "Kei Pathian Bangkim hihthei ka hi. Chi tampi suang in hong pung in. Nam, chih tham ngial leh nam tuamtuam omkhawmte leng nang ah ahong om ding ua, na khal a kipan kumpipate leng ahong pawt ding uhi.
english: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

paite: Abraham leh Isak kiang a ka gam piak na kiang ah ka hon pe ding. Na om louh nung chiang in na suante kiang ah leng gam ka pe zel ding," achi hi.
english: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”

paite: Pathian in ahoupihna mun a kipan Jakob apaitouh santa hi.
english: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

paite: Ahoupihna mun ah Jakob in suangkhuam aphut a; atung ah dawn thillat abuak a, atung ah sathau leng abuak hi.
english: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

paite: Jakob in Pathian in ahoupihna mun min Bethel asa hi.
english: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

paite: Bethel a kipan apaikhia ua; Ephrath kho tunna ding gamlatak ahih lai in Rakil in nau avei a, anak vei mahmah hi.
heading: Rakil Sihna
english: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, agim laitak in naudommi'n, "Lau ke'n, tapa nei nawn ding na hi," achi hi.
english: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, alaitah ding kuan in, (amah lah si dek ahi ngal a), amin Ben-oni asa a; himahleh apa'n Benjamin asa hi.
english: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

paite: Rakil asita a, Ephrath lampi ah avui uh; huai Ephrath khua Bethlehem ahi.
english: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

paite: Ahan tung ah Jakob in suang aphut a; huai tuni tan in Rakil hansuang ahiden hi.
english: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

paite: Israel apai zel a, Migdol Eder khen lam ah apuanin akai hi.
english: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel huai gam a a-om lai in Reuben in apa mei Bilhah ava kithuahpih a; Israel in huai aza hi.
heading: Jakob Tapate / (1 Kro 2.1,2)
english: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

paite: Jakob tapate sawm- le-nih ahi uh. Leah tapate Reuben (Jakob tapa upapen), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakar leh Zebulun ahi uh.
english: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

paite: Rakil tapate Joseph leh Benjamin ahi uh.
english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

paite: Rakil sikhanu Bilhah tapate Dan leh Naphtali ahi uh.
english: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

paite: Leah sikhanu Zilpah tapate Gad leh Asher ahi ua; hiaite Jakob tapa, Padan-aram gam a aneihte ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

paite: Kiriath-arba a Abraham leh Isak omna Mamre ah apa Isak kiang ah Jakob atungta a; Kiriath-arba khua Hebron leng kichi ahi.
heading: Isak Sihna
english: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

paite: Isak damsung kum zakhat-le-sawmgiat ahi.
english: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

paite: Isak in akha akhahta a, upapi tekkun a dam in asi a, huan achipihte kiang ah pi in a-omta hi. Atapate Esau leh Jakob in amah avui uhi.
english: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
